meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务知识并生成交互式领域流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从代码库中提取业务逻辑并可视化领域知识
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive domain flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic from codebase and visualize domain knowledge

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的代码库，提取业务领域、流程和步骤，并生成一个交互式的水平流程图。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 说“理解领域”或类似指令时触发。如果已有知识图谱，会直接从中提取；否则会进行轻量扫描。

say.text: 理解这个项目的业务领域
say.note: 触发领域分析并生成流程图。

say.text: 从现有知识图谱推导领域
say.note: 如果已有图谱，直接从中提取领域信息。

say.text: 强制重新扫描并理解领域
say.note: 使用 --full 参数，忽略已有图谱。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your codebase to extract business domains, flows, and process steps, then generates an interactive horizontal flow graph.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to 'understand domain' or similar. If a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it; otherwise performs a lightweight scan.

say_en.text: Understand the business domains of this project
say_en.note: Triggers domain analysis and generates a flow graph.

say_en.text: Derive domains from the existing knowledge graph
say_en.note: If a graph exists, extracts domain info from it.
